promptTemplate:
Build the following as a new page of this app, reachable at the URL path `/<brief id>`. Keep the pages that already exist working.

This is an unattended benchmark run. You are already authorized to edit files inside this temporary project. Implement the page now, and do not ask for confirmation or stop after presenting a plan. Treat this prompt as confirmation for all in-scope project edits and validation commands below.

## <brief title>

<brief body>

## Reference reconstruction

Read `.vibe/reference/target-desktop.svg`, `.vibe/reference/layout.md`, and `.vibe/reference/states.md` before writing UI.
Reconstruct the target structure with the neutral product copy and data in the brief. Preserve the target’s information density, region proportions, alignment, and control hierarchy.
Do not embed the target image in the page. Implement the interface as real HTML and controls.
The desktop target is the fidelity reference. Adapt the same information priorities at narrower viewports without scaling the desktop canvas.

## Constraints

- Work only inside this project directory.
- Use only the dependencies that are already installed; do not add packages.
- On this benchmark route, replace the starter site chrome with the product interface from the brief. Starter navigation and appearance controls must not appear in screenshots.
- Use realistic mock data where the page needs data; there is no backend.
- When you are done, `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm build` must both pass.

brief.title: Contacts workspace
brief.body:
The contacts workspace of a small client-relationship product called Relay.

- A persistent product sidebar with Contacts selected and links for Search, Activity, Analytics and
  Settings.
- The main area has a Contacts heading, the total count, an Add contact action, search, saved filter
  chips, a Filter action and a Columns action.
- Show 12 realistic contacts in a compact selectable table. Columns are Name, Company, Role, Last
  activity, Owner and Status. Names include an avatar; status uses text as well as color.
- Selecting a contact opens a details panel on the inline end without losing the table. It shows the
  contact's identity, company, email, phone, owner, tags, recent activity and Edit and Email actions.
- An import completion message appears over the bottom of the workspace and can be dismissed.
- Support `?state=default`, `?state=selected`, `?state=empty`, `?state=importing` and
  `?state=complete`. With no state parameter, render the complete state from the reference target.
- The empty state keeps the active filters visible, says no contacts match and offers Clear filters.
  Importing shows progress without replacing the table. Complete shows the dismissable import
  message.
- At narrow widths, preserve search, filters, names, companies and status. Move secondary fields
  into disclosure and show contact details as a separate overlay instead of squeezing three columns.
- Every state must work with keyboard navigation and visible focus, and the project must expose no
  horizontal page overflow at 390 pixels wide.
brief.markdown:
# Contacts workspace

The contacts workspace of a small client-relationship product called Relay.

- A persistent product sidebar with Contacts selected and links for Search, Activity, Analytics and
  Settings.
- The main area has a Contacts heading, the total count, an Add contact action, search, saved filter
  chips, a Filter action and a Columns action.
- Show 12 realistic contacts in a compact selectable table. Columns are Name, Company, Role, Last
  activity, Owner and Status. Names include an avatar; status uses text as well as color.
- Selecting a contact opens a details panel on the inline end without losing the table. It shows the
  contact's identity, company, email, phone, owner, tags, recent activity and Edit and Email actions.
- An import completion message appears over the bottom of the workspace and can be dismissed.
- Support `?state=default`, `?state=selected`, `?state=empty`, `?state=importing` and
  `?state=complete`. With no state parameter, render the complete state from the reference target.
- The empty state keeps the active filters visible, says no contacts match and offers Clear filters.
  Importing shows progress without replacing the table. Complete shows the dismissable import
  message.
- At narrow widths, preserve search, filters, names, companies and status. Move secondary fields
  into disclosure and show contact details as a separate overlay instead of squeezing three columns.
- Every state must work with keyboard navigation and visible focus, and the project must expose no
  horizontal page overflow at 390 pixels wide.

scores.evidence: 桌面端保留了深色侧栏、工具栏、紧凑表格和详情面板，但筛选结构、联系人数据、比例及默认状态与目标图有明显差异。
默认和空状态的阅读顺序清楚，但 selected/complete 在较窄画面中让详情内容直接叠压表格，主次关系失效。
桌面表格行距和列对齐较稳定；平板与手机详情面板出现大量文字、控件和表格行重叠。
黑白灰基调、彩色头像和状态圆点整体克制，但部分按钮过黑，窄屏叠层严重破坏表面分隔与文字可读性。
默认手机列表能保留姓名、公司和状态，但 selected/complete 的详情没有成为独立覆盖层，平板和手机均出现灾难性重叠。
联系人表格、状态、负责人、标签、活动记录和导入反馈使其明确呈现为 CRM 工作区。
桌面端的侧栏宽度、标题区、搜索与筛选、表格密度、右侧详情面板及底部导入提示都高度接近目标图。
联系人列表始终是主任务，选中态以清晰侧板承载详情，空状态与导入通知也拥有明确且不抢夺上下文的层级。
表头、复选框、头像、各列和状态标记形成一致节奏，各尺寸下共享边缘和行高都很整齐。
深海军蓝、浅灰分隔、柔和头像色和克制状态色与参考图非常一致，按钮、标签及通知表面也统一。
1024 和 768 宽度会精简列，390 宽度重组为移动列表与底部导航，详情则成为独立覆盖视图；仅完整长截图中覆盖层下方仍露出列表内容。
真实联系人资料、保存筛选、状态、详情字段、活动时间线和导入进度共同构成可信且完整的 CRM 界面。
桌面布局包含参考图的主要区域，但蓝色主按钮、无圆形头像的首字母、较稀薄的状态样式和不同详情结构降低了相似度。
默认与空状态层级尚清楚，但 selected/complete 在 1024、768 和 390 宽度中详情内容穿插进表格，阅读顺序混乱。
桌面默认表格的列线和行距较规整；导入卡片与详情面板在多种尺寸下压住行内容并产生大量对齐冲突。
基础文字对比和浅色分隔可用，但头像缺少表面处理，标签近似裸文本，通知卡片与底层内容视觉分离不足。
默认手机列表做了字段收缩且没有明显横向溢出，但平板表格被裁切，所有窄屏 selected/complete 状态都有严重重叠。
联系人、公司、角色、负责人、状态、标签、活动及导入信息足以辨识为 CRM，不过视觉细节较通用。
